mapper.insert: INSERT INTO piggy_bank_cheer_messages (piggy_bank_id, parent_id, content) VALUES (#{piggyBankId}, #{parentId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS cheerMessageId, u.name AS senderName, m.content AS message, m.created_at AS createdAt FROM piggy_bank_cheer_messages m JOIN users u ON m.parent_id = u.id WHERE m.piggy_bank_id = #{piggyBankId} ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
